content: Sapotyadeda Jesús riy tadajyo vara̱nca vadube
Rivasiñuma ji̱ta saya̱da Jesús Cadidéya jmityo̱ rudamyuju̱ntiy jiryatiy Tibéryasiy jtyatarara.
Richiityari̱jada nijya̱mi̱juuvedabay variñi̱, jiryatiy ridyiyada riva mityamusiy dityadoda simusiy, jiryatiy sami̱sadeda riy jdiva̱jnuvabe daryaju̱ ridyiya.
Sa̱subeda ji̱ta Jesús variy musiquincha, sama̱sa̱da variy jasiy yisa̱ datyavavyedabatya.
Ratuudiya̱jadanuma Judíyuveda vichtya, Pásco jtyatara variy.
Su̱nu̱yasubeda ji̱ta Jesús variy, sadiyada ruuva nijya̱nvajyuuvedabay jiryatiy ru̱deda simuju̱, su̱teda variy siva Vedípebe: “¿Tesiña̱ vurya̱ta̱ryu̱rya pa̱ riibyedaju̱ jivye nijya̱nvay, tesiy?”
Mitya sitaja̱doda Jesúsni̱ Vedípebe sa̱tidye jantya saniy, sadatyanu̱yadanuma daryaju̱ nu̱tyura ra̱jvaarya.
Su̱mutya̱jada Vedípebe variñi̱ Jesús: “Daraju̱y vu̱yaju̱chuy pa̱ ne richa̱ra̱ ntate ra̱cha rirya̱jmutya̱jay nu̱ñi ti̱quimusiy rate.”

Antrésibe ji̱ta, Jesúsjsa̱ datyavay tenubay jiryatiy Siimyó̱ Pyítrubay taryi̱ni̱, ni̱ni̱ rañi jteda variy siva Jesús: “Jiñutiñi̱ muchechiy tadajyojo pa̱ti̱, danu̱ju̱y quiva̱ju̱y risa̱ju̱ntiy. ¿Ta̱ra rani̱cha jirya nijya̱nvajyu̱, ta̱ra?”
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy siva: “Ya̱jtay ruuva nijya̱nvay: Jirya̱ma̱samu̱y ti̱ta̱ju̱.” Ravichanu̱yada vachujyuusuma jasiy. Rimya̱sa̱da tadajyo vara̱ncatuunu vaduy variy rancha.
Sapu̱ya̱da ji̱ta Jesús varirya pa̱. Si̱chana̱tyamu̱yadanumatiñi̱ jijye̱, sasa̱yada ji̱ta variy ruuva ma̱savarya pa̱. Daryaday sasa̱yada quiva̱ jve risa̱ju̱ntiryi, jasicha̱ra̱ju̱tiy rivya̱ta̱da.
Ripyoyadanumatiy nijya̱nvay riva, su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva yisa̱ datyavay: “Jirya̱numa jatora jmyichara jnura ti̱ta̱ju̱, rañuma pa̱chitye, mitya.”
Rirya̱tojada variy jtyu panujora jmyichara jnura, vu̱yaju̱y jtyu dajtyuju̱y ranchaju̱, jiryatiy tadajyojo pa̱ jnurara, jiryatimyu̱ ne riimyimyu̱yada nijya̱nvarya.
Ridyiyadanumatiy nijya̱nvay riva mityamusiy sivaayada, ru̱teda variy yiva: “Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta si̱tenu vichasara Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chu̱ jiryatiy jirya mucadimuju̱ jti̱jasi̱ni̱.”
Sadatya̱danumatiy Jesús: ruuriryu̱y nijya̱nvayu, jiryatiy riñi jtay yá̱bay yintyityu̱ju̱ni̱, sanumuteda yasiquita variy jadchiy, musiquimuju̱.
Jesús rupiyada ja̱a̱dutuvya

Ri̱ñupuyadanumatiy, ru̱musa̱da ji̱ta Jesúsjsa̱ datyavavyedabay musajomuju̱ variy, ru̱musa̱da variy cartyevimu, rijyo̱ta̱da ramityeda Capernavú̱muju̱ varintyi. Nupocudenumatiy ravicha̱da, ne su̱niñu̱yada Jesús ruumuju̱ variy didye.
Ri̱ye̱yasubeda ji̱ta jmityo̱ variy ja̱mu riichomusiy.
Tadajyo vara̱nca metru tuununumatiy richeya̱jada, ridyiyada variy siva Jesús sarupi ja̱a̱dutuvya. Jiryatiy satuudiya̱jadara cartye, richuvu̱yada variñi̱.
Su̱teda Jesús variy ruuva: “Randye, ne jirya̱suvu̱y.”
Ru̱mutya̱ru̱yada variy cartyevimuju̱ni̱. Varicha̱ra̱ju̱ rito̱jada cartye musajomu, jasijyu̱tiy riya̱da.
Nijya̱nvajyuuvedabay va̱ta̱da sana̱cho̱ Jesús

Ratarya rundamu rivyicha̱da nijya̱nvavyedabay ru̱biva jmityo̱ rudamyu. Ridyetya̱dama̱ daryaju̱ richipyataje Jesúsjsa̱ datyavavyeda cartyevimu, ne ridyije siva Jesús ruusa̱ variy, jiryatiy ridyetya̱da daryaju̱ vinu tajnuqui cartye jasiy.
Riti̱jada varicha̱ra̱ju̱ cartyevicha̱ Tibéryasimyusiy ruumu. Rivyicha̱da nijya̱nvay vichajotuunu variy jiryatiy riibyedara pa̱ variy jasiy, jiryatiy si̱chana̱tya̱da Jesúsra.
Jiryatimyu̱ ne ridyiyada nijya̱nvavyedabay jasiy siva Jesús, dantyamu̱y ne sisa̱ datyavavyedabay, ru̱musa̱da variy cartyevicha̱vimuju̱, riya̱da variy Capernavú̱mu, Jesúsna̱cho̱.
Jesús vichasara pa̱ ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadaju̱
Richeryenuvejadanumatiy jmityo̱ rudamyuni̱, ruutaja̱doda ji̱ta variñi̱: “¿Nu̱tyeryivyenuma yiti̱jay jiyuntiy, Datyanu̱, nu̱tyeryivye?”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variryi: “Si̱tenute ri̱tay jiryivacu̱: Jiryevya̱ta rañe̱cho̱ jiryatiy jiryi̱myije daryaju̱ra pa̱, jiryepyoje ti̱ta̱ju̱ riva. Ne jiryevya̱ta rañe̱cho̱ jiryatiy jiryeñi dije riva mityamusiy jvaayada.

Jirya̱jvaay, ne vinu jmyichara varenu jarapu̱rya jiryedaju̱. Jirya̱jvaay ji̱ta jirya̱tidye jmyirya jiryatiy ra̱suru̱chara ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadaju̱, jiryatiy sa̱sa̱chara Nijya̱mi̱denu jiryerya. Vu̱jye̱ ji̱ta ni̱tiy Ju̱denu day, sani jantyama̱ daryaju̱ dañi̱ Nijya̱mi̱denu day.”
Ruutaja̱doda ji̱ta variñi̱ Jesús: “¿Nu̱tyura jvaayada nu̱ña̱jvaachara Ju̱denu jacharaju̱, nu̱tyura?”
Su̱mutya̱jada Jesús variryi: “Sava̱tasara ji̱ta Ju̱denu jirya̱tidye tuva̱chu simu su̱pa̱nu. Rani̱ ji̱ta sabay jiryivaayadaju̱ day.”
Ruutaja̱doda variy jasintyiñi̱: “¿Ta̱ra mityamusiy dityadoda yimu, ta̱ra? nu̱ña̱tidye diy riva, nu̱ña̱tidye tuva̱chu variy yimu. ¿Ta̱rana̱ yivaachara, ta̱ra?
Nu̱myunatyavatye jbyedatera nu̱tyu paji mityatomute. Daryanuma nu̱chara darya, jiryatiy sasa̱yada Muyusésibe riibyedaju̱ra pa̱ jiryatiy jarichumusidyerya.”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variryi: “Si̱tenute ri̱tay jiryivacu̱: Ne sasa̱yada Muyusésibe pa̱ jirye, jiryatiy jarichumusidyerya, rajye̱ ji̱ta sa̱yada darya. Ni̱day ji̱ta sa̱chara diye jarichumusirya pa̱ntiy, jiryatiy si̱tenu jmyichara darya.
Ju̱denu pa̱ ji̱ta sani̱cha jiñu daryaju̱, ni̱tiy jmusa̱da jarichuvimusiy, sasa̱chara varirya ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yada nijya̱nvajyu̱.”
Ru̱teda ji̱ta variy siva Jesús: “Ya̱numa sa̱jeya̱sara nu̱rya jirya pa̱, Nutyityu̱.”
Su̱teda Jesús variy ruuva: “Rañi rañi̱cha pa̱ rañityi jirya̱jnu̱y. Ni̱tiy jnichara rimu, netaramu sa̱jachi̱saranu̱day, daryadantyi ni̱tiy tuva̱chusara rimu, netaramu sa̱jchu̱mu̱charanu̱day.
Dañuma rañi niquemu̱y jiryiva: Dañuma jiryeñi dimya̱ rivantiy, ne vinu daryamusiy jiryetyuva̱churu̱y variy rimu.
Ti̱ta̱ju̱ nijya̱nvay jiryatiy sasa̱chara rajye̱rye, rirya̱jti̱ variy rimu. Ni̱tiy jniy rimu, ne ra̱rrachu variñi̱, tii, mitya.
Ri̱musa̱da ji̱ta jarichumusiy ra̱tidye jvaarya ri̱pa̱nu va̱tara, ne ra̱jvaarya radyirya va̱tasara day, mitya.
Jiryani̱ ji̱ta ri̱pa̱nu va̱tara, jiryatimyu̱ ne sa̱care ti̱ ritye jiryatiy sasa̱yada rirye, ra̱tidye mi̱sadesumiy tamitya rundamu ti̱ta̱ju̱ riy.
Tapi rani̱ ji̱ta sava̱tasara rajye̱, mi̱ni̱tyi ra̱diy siva sadenu, saryityi tuva̱chu variy simu, saryi jnu̱jeya̱sara variy ta̱rijyu̱, ra̱tidye mi̱sadesumiy tamitya rundamu variñi̱.”
Ricyucuye̱yada ji̱ta Judíyuveda nutyityu̱mibe variy sanijyu̱ Jesús, jiryatiy su̱teda daryaju̱: “Rañi rañi̱cha pa̱ jiryatiy jarichuvimusiy jmusarara.”
Ru̱teda ji̱ta variy: “¿Ni̱ni̱ta Jesús, Jusíy denu, jiryatiy vu̱dyetyasarani̱ saja̱y, su̱no̱da jarye? ¿Nu̱tyuramusiña̱ su̱tay variy, nu̱tyuramusiy? rañi jmusa̱da jarichuvimusiy.”
Su̱mutya̱jada Jesús variryi: “Jirya̱numa paru̱y riva jiccuye̱yada.
Ne vana̱y ti̱ jniy rimuju̱, netimyu̱ ne satiiy rajye̱ñi̱. Su̱pa̱jada ji̱ta rajye̱rye, rajeryetidye ra̱mi̱saniy diibyimusiy tamitya rundamu riy jiryatiy satiiy rajye̱ rimuju̱ riy.

Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chuvabe catera padyemyu nu̱charara: Rirye̱chasara dyetya Ju̱denumusiy datyanusavay ti̱ta̱ju̱. Ramuni̱tiy rityi tuva̱chusara simu rajye̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱, ridyetyasara variy simusiy, ru̱nichara variy rimuju̱.
Ne ti̱ diyada siva rajye̱, vinu ni̱ jiryatiy simusi̱ni̱, ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta diyada siva day.
Si̱tenute ri̱tay jiryivacu̱: Ni̱tiy tuva̱chu simu, ni̱ni̱ vichasara ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadati̱.
Rañi rañi̱cha pa̱ ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadaju̱.
Dañuma riñi jbyeda jiryemyunatyavarya paji mityatomu, jasintya ridyiimyu̱yada day.
Jiryatirya pa̱ jarichumusiryá. Ni̱tiy ra̱jmyirya, ne sa̱diichara variñu̱day, mitya.

Rañi rañi̱cha pa̱ ju̱nu̱ñu, jiryatiy jarichumusiy jmusarara. Ni̱tiy ra̱jmyichara jirya pa̱te, sa̱jnu̱jeya̱sara variy ju̱na̱reju̱. Jirya pa̱, jiryatiy ra̱sa̱charára, rani̱ ji̱ta rachavidye jiryatiy ra̱sa̱chara mucadi ja̱nvay jnu̱yadaju̱ra.”
Judíyuveda nutyityu̱mibe ji̱ta jo̱ta̱da niquetta̱da ranchiyu: “¿Nu̱tyuramusiña̱ sa̱sa̱y jiñu vuryi̱byedaju̱ra jichaviy, nu̱tyuramusiy?”

Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva: “Si̱tenute ri̱tay jiryivacu̱: Netimyu̱ ne jirye̱jmyi ntara Nijya̱mi̱denu saviy, netimyu̱ ne jirya̱jatu nta risa̱ju̱ntirya sandaja̱ntiy, ne jirye̱chasara variy jnu̱yadatavay.
Ni̱tiy jmyirya rachaviy, sa̱tu risa̱ju̱ra rayndaja̱, ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta ra̱vichasara ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yadaju̱, ra̱day mi̱sanitye diibyimusiy tamitya rundamute varityeni̱.
Rachaviy ji̱ta daryaju̱ si̱tenu jmyichara day, rayndaja̱ jarye si̱tenu jatusara risa̱ju̱.
Ni̱tiy jmyicharara rachaviy, sa̱tusara risa̱ju̱ra rayndaja̱ntiy, ni̱ni̱ ma̱cho̱sara variy rimu, rajerye ma̱cho̱sara variy simuntidye.
Jiryatiy rajye̱ jnu̱ñu jpa̱jada ray, ray ji̱ta vichasara simusiy. Daryamusiñi̱, ni̱tiy jmyirye, sa̱jnu̱jeya̱sara rimusiy.

Jiryatirya pa̱, jiryatiy jarichumusiy jmusarara. Ni̱tiy jmyirya jirya pa̱, sa̱jnu̱jeya̱sara ju̱na̱reju̱ variy, ne sa̱diichara variñu̱day nu̱tyu ridyiiñu̱yada jiryemyunatyavay, jiryatiy riibyedara paji daryá.”
Jirya ti̱ta̱ju̱ su̱teda Jesús jiryatiy sadatyadoda ju̱tye̱ryanijyomura, Capernavú̱mu.
Ju̱denu niquejada ji̱ta vichasara ramusityi vurya̱jnu̱jeya̱sara ju̱na̱reju̱
Ramuni̱tiy, rityuva̱chodanumatiy rajuuvay sisa̱ datyavavyedabarya jiñiquejada, ru̱teda variy ranchiy: “Rani̱ ji̱ta surra niquejada si̱tenu: ne chi̱ raryi tuva̱chu ramu.”
Sadatya̱danumatiy Jesús jivyimu jiryatiy ricyucuye̱yada sisa̱ datyavavyeda saniquejadanchiy, su̱teda variy ruuva: “¿Ramuni̱ dyetya jiryepyaru̱ryu̱y riva rachiityari̱sa̱da?
¿Nu̱tyu raryicha variy, nu̱tyu? saryityi jasumiy Nijya̱mi̱denu yibivaju̱ntiy. ¿Jiryetyi ra̱ryiryi̱ tuva̱choda variy rimu?
Vuryi̱ntumusiy ji̱ta vuryi̱nu̱y, ne ru̱mu̱tya vu̱chaviy taraju̱ vu̱y. Rañiquejada ji̱ta jiryatiy rañiquejasiy jiryivara, rani̱ ji̱ta jnututara day, ramusiñi̱ ji̱ta jirya̱jnu̱jeya̱sara day.

Dañuma rani̱chasara rañiquejada jiryi̱nu̱yadaju̱, ne vinu daryamusiy rityuva̱churu̱y jiryetyevay rimu.” Sadatya̱dama̱ Jesús rajo̱ttya̱musiy daryaju̱: “Muvye ne ra̱tuva̱churu̱chara rimu, muvye; chi̱ra ra̱sa̱y ramyityasimyimyu ray, chi̱.”
Su̱teda Jesús variy: “Ramuni̱ ri̱tesiy jiryiva: Ne vana̱y siti̱ nijya̱mi̱ rimu, netimyu̱ ne sasa̱y rajye̱ jti̱jadaju̱ni̱.”
Daryamuni̱day rityochiya̱jada sisa̱ datyavajyuubeyu, ne richiityari̱ru̱yada variñu̱nñi̱.
Sitaja̱doda ji̱ta Jesús variryi vu̱yaju̱y, danu̱ju̱y rinchaju̱: “¿Jiryejeryevyi jiyaru̱y?”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Siimyó̱ Pyítrubay variñi̱: “¿Chi̱muju̱ra nu̱ña̱jiya, chi̱muju̱? Nu̱ñi̱nu̱tya̱ju̱ niquejada ji̱ta yimu day.
Nu̱y ji̱ta si̱tenu jachipiya̱, nu̱dyetyama̱ ji̱ta si̱tenu diye ji. Jiñi̱ jiñi̱cha Ju̱denu jiintyasi̱.”
Su̱mutya̱jada Jesús variñi̱: “¿Ne yinu̱y rajeryeta̱da jiryedye, jiryatiy vu̱yaju̱y vaduy, danu̱ju̱y ranchaju̱ jirye? Ti̱qui ji̱ta jiryetyenu vichasara bayantu.”
Sani jteda Jesús jirya niquejadata Judásiy Iscaryótibenchiy, jiryatiy Siimyó̱bay denubañi̱. Tapi dañuma sani̱cha̱da sisa̱ datyavavyedabay tenu, jiryatiy sa̱sa̱yasiy samityasimyimyu Jesúsyu.
